name: The Margot
note: 1321 Mission Street at 9th (opened as the Panoramic): eleven storeys of affordable housing clad in flat metal rainscreen panels, cream with a silver-grey wing at the 10th Street end, staggered punched windows, a sawtooth of angled window bays mid-front, a glass shopfront under a canopy, and the blue red-edged THE MARGOT blade sign on the corner. From the owner's Street View frame (Sep 2026, from 1310 Mission) and Mapillary docs/shots/refs/margot (01). Replaces the 2026-10-04 rule-check restyle in tierB-2.json (blue stucco, read off pre-rename frames). Builder: src/render/landmarks/sf/margot.ts; the panels are the `panel` surface in cartoon-material.ts.
